description: This file defines the Coupon model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling the calculation and application of coupon discounts during checkout, as well as validation and history management related to coupons.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A class managing coupon calculations, validations, and history updates in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total discount from a coupon and adjusts the total price and taxes accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates and records the application of a coupon based on order information.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes coupon histories associated with a specific order, typically upon order cancellation or modification.
